purpose: Append-only prospective monitoring of the already frozen Type-I T+5 lifecycle evidence after all retrospective confirmatory datasets have been consumed.

event_clock.source: M2.17 source-aligned Terminal Price Bar reconstructed from no-lookahead forming projections
event_clock.endpoint: first T2 hit during T+6..T+20 among events still pending T2 at T+5

registration.reason: At T+5 the exposure/comparator is observable while the T+6..T+20 endpoint window has not yet begun. Events first discovered after T+5 are retained as audit backfills but permanently excluded from a future prospective primary evaluation.

inference.reason: The registry is an evidence ledger only. A future confirmatory evaluation requires a separate preregistration before its endpoint outcomes are used for inference.
